lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Case one, Meera versus Harish. All persons stand for the presiding arbitrator.
lines.sfx_cue: wooden staff strikes floor, chairs scrape

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Sir, before you begin, I require the previous case number.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You require it? On your first morning itself? Please sit, Naina. Learn the room before correcting it.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: I am not correcting the room, sir. The register begins with today's entry. I cannot find the earlier numbers.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: And yet the hearing has begun. Meera, kindly state what you want.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Possession of my father's twelve-acre orchard, sir. Harish has the keys, the crop account and the north gate.

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: I have maintained that orchard for eleven years. She came after our father died and demanded everything.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Because he left it to me, bhai. You know that.

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: I know what is lawful. I will obey a lawful order, even if it goes against me.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Sir, that is precisely why the case number matters. A competent forum must maintain continuity of proceedings.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Staff, did anyone ask for a lecture on competent forums?

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: No, sir.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: No, presiding sir. The recording is running.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Meera? Did you ask my new clerk for a lecture?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: No, sir. I only want my orchard.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Harish? Perhaps you requested a speech about registers.

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: No, sir. I came for judgment.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: There, Naina. Four people understood the purpose of a hearing. Only the clerk is confused.

lines.speaker: VOICE FROM STAFF
lines.text: Maybe she requires a register to remember where she is.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Sir, I... I only asked because the first page says the register opened five years ago.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Correct. And a qualified clerk would infer that earlier records have been archived.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Then kindly give me the archive reference. I will enter it beside today's case.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You have been here for twenty-three minutes, and already you are delaying citizens who have waited months.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Madam, please. Let him hear us first. Small small office matters can happen later.

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: A court should not be made to wait for its clerk.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Yes. I understand.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: No, you do not. Salim, remove her chair.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Sir, the chair is fixed under the record desk.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Then use both hands. Kindly do the needful.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Naina madam, thoda side, please.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Sir, where should I record the evidence?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Standing beside Salim. Perhaps discomfort will improve your concentration.

lines.speaker: VOICE FROM STAFF
lines.text: Now she is looking like an usher only.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Enough. The recording is catching everything.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Let it catch. Transparency is the dignity of this tribunal.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Yes, sir.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Write. Case one. The claimant seeks exclusive possession of twelve acres formerly held by her late father.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Case one of which year, sir?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Naina.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: I need the year for the index.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Write the current year. Do not convert ignorance into procedure.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: I have already typed the heading, sir.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Excellent. One employee arrived prepared.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Sir, my father's memorandum names me. Harish took the original after the funeral.

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: For safekeeping. Not theft.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You will both submit your papers tomorrow. Until then, Harish will not disturb Meera's present access.

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: If that is the court's direction, I will obey.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Thank you, sir.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Hearing adjourned. Salim, clear the room. Naina stays.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: All claimants outside. Take your papers. Slowly, slowly.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Your application said you had three years of record-room experience.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Three years and eight months, sir. Civil typing, indexing and certified-copy preparation.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Yet you challenged the bench before claimants, staff and an active recording machine.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: I asked for a number. A missing number can invalidate every reference after it.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: This is not the typing shop that dismissed you. Here, discipline may still compensate for qualification.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: That shop dismissed me without checking the original dictation.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Everyone dismissed from somewhere has an original dictation. Do one thing. Bring the master register from my cupboard.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Which key, sir?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The brass one. And Naina... if you open a cupboard, close it exactly as you found it.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Yes, sir.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: This is the master register?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: It says so on the cover, does it not.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Five years of tribunal matters should fill several volumes.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Find today's case and prepare the daily abstract.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Sir... there are no earlier entries.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: The tribunal's supposedly five-year-old master register is blank, except for the case I entered this morning.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Close that register, Naina. Now.
lines.sfx_cue: cupboard door slams, ledger pages snap shut

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Not until you explain why five years of judicial records are missing.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Judicial records are not missing. Their index has not been migrated.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Migrated from where? There is no archive reference, disposal list or old volume.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You wanted permanent work, no? This is the work.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Permanent work does not mean inventing records.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Careful. Nobody has asked you to invent anything.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Then show me one earlier case file.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Pooja, bring the numbering sheet.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: Sir... that sheet is only rough planning.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Today it becomes an administrative index.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: There are three hundred and twenty-six numbers on this page.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Correct. Enter them before the case you recorded this morning.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: With what names? What filing dates? What orders?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Only case number, year and status. Mark each one transferred to archive.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: An archive that does not exist.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: An archive that is presently unavailable. Use accurate language in a legal office.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Sir, should I stop the recording? The hearing is over.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Yes. Private administrative work need not consume tape.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Stopped, sir.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Now, Naina. Kindly begin with case one of the first year.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: I will not certify three hundred and twenty-six nonexistent cases.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Certify? No. You are merely preparing an index from data supplied by your superior.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: There is no data. There are only numbers.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Numbers are the spine of a record. You said that before the full staff, did you not.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: I said continuity requires genuine numbers.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: And I am giving you continuity. Three hundred and twenty-six entries of it.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: Naina, do it in pencil first. If sir changes the sequence, ink will become a headache.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: You knew the register was blank?

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: I knew sir kept it locked. That is all I knew.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Pooja understands the limits of her designation. That is why she still has a chair.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: My employment declaration says record clerk, not author of past proceedings.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: It also says you accept responsibility for accurate preparation and maintenance of tribunal records.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Accurate preparation. This is false preparation.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: That is an accusation. Accusations require evidence, qualifications and an appropriate forum. You presently have none of the three.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: If any authority inspects this register—

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: They will see your handwriting. So I suggest you make it neat.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Sir, perhaps we can say the old index was water-damaged. Water happens in every office.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Thank you, Salim. Do not improve documents unless instructed.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Yes, sir. I was only... achha, I will lock the front door.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: You are keeping me here after closing?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You delayed the morning hearing. You will restore that time today only.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Three hundred and twenty-six entries will take hours.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Then conversation is expensive. Begin.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Case one. First year. Transferred to archive.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Case two. First year. Transferred to archive.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: Leave six lines after every fifty cases. It looks more natural if the years do not finish evenly.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: More natural? Pooja, how many times have you done this?

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: I type what comes on my desk. I don't... I don't ask where it lived before that.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: A sensible employee does not interrogate paper.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Paper does not go to prison. People do.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: An excellent reason to follow written instructions from a superior.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Give me that instruction in writing.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Certainly. Pooja, note: clerk directed to update pending migration work as part of routine duties.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: No. Write that the files were not produced for verification.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Pooja will type my instruction, not your anxiety.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: Sir, tomorrow's orchard order is also pending.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Prepare it now. Exclusive possession to Meera, subject to document verification.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Their evidence has not been submitted yet.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: And therefore the order remains subject to verification. Legal language exists to solve these small small difficulties.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: Meera's name in the heading, Harish as respondent?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Yes. Twelve-acre orchard. Effective immediately.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: You are deciding tomorrow's hearing tonight.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I am reducing administrative delay. Continue your index.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Behind Pooja's desk, one carbon copy slid under the skirting board. Nobody saw it remain there.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Case one hundred and eighty-nine. Fourth year. Transferred to archive.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: Your hand is shaking. Drink water.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: My hand is writing lies in permanent ink.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Your hand is completing probation work. The difference is attitude.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two hours later, the invented history reached the final page.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Case three hundred and twenty-six. Fifth year. Transferred to archive.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Then today's orchard dispute becomes case three hundred and twenty-seven. The sequence is continuous.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: The sequence is manufactured.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Your opinion has been noted verbally and nowhere else.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: I want my employment declaration returned.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The declaration belongs in your service file.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: That is not my service file.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: No. This is safer.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I am placing your signed employment declaration inside the false register, Naina.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: If the police open it, they will treat the register's author as the creator of this court.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Stop typing. The word orchard is misspelled in a final order.
lines.sfx_cue: typewriter bell, paper ripped from carriage

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: Sir, I can correct it in two minutes.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You will not touch it. Naina certified the copy.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: I certified that it matched the office copy. I did not type this order.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The office copy says orchad. Your certified copy says orchad. The error belongs to records.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: The error belongs to whoever typed it before yesterday's evidence was filed.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: Naina, bas. Correct the spelling and issue a fresh copy.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: No quiet correction. Claimants are waiting. They deserve transparency.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Meera and Harish are outside, sir. Shall I keep them there?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Call them in. Call the staff also. The tribunal will address this publicly.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Sir, a typographical error can be corrected by memorandum. There is no need to humiliate anyone.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: An employee who fears humiliation usually knows where responsibility lies.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Meera, Harish, come inside. Staff members also. Recording is starting.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Sir, has Harish challenged yesterday's order?

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: I have challenged nothing. I obeyed it. I gave her the north-gate key this morning.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And the crop account?

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: That also. I said I would obey a lawful order.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Your obedience is noted. Unfortunately, my records clerk has issued you a defective judgment.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Defective how? Does it cancel my possession?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The word orchard is missing one letter.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: One letter? The land is still twelve acres, no? The survey description is there?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: A judgment is not a vegetable list, Meera. Every word carries authority.

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: Then the order I obeyed is invalid?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I did not say invalid. I said defective because Naina failed to examine it.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Sir, kindly show them the typed office copy. The same spelling appears there.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Of course it does. Your function was to prevent that error from leaving this office.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: The function of certification is comparison. Both copies matched exactly.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Listen to her. She is proud that she reproduced a mistake exactly.

lines.speaker: VOICE FROM STAFF
lines.text: Yesterday she knew more than the bench. Today she cannot spell orchard.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Madam, this paper controls my father's land. You should have checked properly.

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: I surrendered possession because I believed this was a court order. Such mistakes damage both of us.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: I understand. But I did not decide or type—

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Do not distribute your duty among others. Stand beside the bench.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Sir, may I first inspect the draft history? The order was prepared before the hearing.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: That is irrelevant and untrue.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: Sir, perhaps I should check the ribbon impression. It may show—

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Pooja, your job is typing. Naina's job is records. Keep those boundaries clear.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: The recording is running, sir.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Good. Let the record reflect accountability. Naina, what is your monthly salary?

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Eleven thousand eight hundred rupees, sir.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Your entire salary for this month is docked.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: The entire month? For one missing letter?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: For negligence, public embarrassment to the tribunal and risk caused to two claimants.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: My appointment declaration does not permit a full-month deduction without written inquiry.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Your appointment declaration is presently securing the master register you prepared yesterday.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: You forced me to prepare that index.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Is that your statement before Meera, Harish, the staff and this recording machine?

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: I... I am asking for an inquiry into today's error.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: A wise correction. The salary deduction stands.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Sir, I do not need her whole salary. I only need a proper order.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Your generosity does you credit. Discipline is not yours to waive.

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: If the corrected order is lawful, I will continue obeying it. But I want the original examined.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Certainly. Where is your issued copy?

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: In my document bag outside.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Bring it. We will compare every line.

lines.speaker: harish
lines.text: I will return in five minutes.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: While we wait, Naina will apologise to both affected parties from the bench.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: From the bench?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Yes. The error travelled under the tribunal seal. The apology will carry equal visibility.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: I can apologise from here.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You may also resign from there. The choice is entirely yours.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Naina madam, the step is on your left.

lines.speaker: VOICE FROM STAFF
lines.text: Careful. Even the bench spelling must be correct today.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Meera, I apologise that the certified order issued to you contained a spelling error.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Contained an error because of what?

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Because... because I did not stop its issue.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Will my possession remain protected?

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: The correction should not change the operative direction.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You are not authorised to advise her. Finish the apology.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Meera, I am sorry.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Now Harish, though he is presently outside. The recording will preserve it for him.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Harish, I apologise that you surrendered the orchard keys on a defective copy.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: And for causing him doubt about this tribunal's competence.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: I will not apologise for asking whether this tribunal is competent.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Then your probation can end today.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Sir... please. I need this appointment.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Then use it respectfully.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Harish, I apologise for causing you doubt about the tribunal's competence.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Madam, come down. This is enough.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: It is enough when the bench says so.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: Sir, I have typed the correction memorandum.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Give it to Naina. She will certify it correctly this time.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: The order date is yesterday, but this correction says the error was noticed during pronouncement.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Because that is the administratively appropriate description.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: It was noticed this morning, after pronouncement and after possession changed hands.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: You have already sacrificed one salary. Do not become ambitious.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Someone is coming with Harish. Two persons.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Then return to your place. No claimant should see a clerk standing on the bench.

lines.speaker: naina
lines.text: Yesterday you made me stand beside the usher. Today you made me apologise from your chair.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: And tomorrow may still be available to you, if you learn.

lines.speaker: salim
lines.text: Harish has returned carrying the orchard order. A real advocate is beside him.
lines.sfx_cue: door opens sharply, legal file clasps rattle

lines.speaker: arvind
lines.text: Naina. I recognise you. You are the typist I dismissed from my office.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Naina asks for the missing earlier case numbers during Meera and Harish's first hearing, and Devraj publicly ridicules the question.

state_changes.fact: Her concern about missing case numbers becomes public before staff and claimants.
He refuses to produce an archive reference for earlier cases.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Devraj orders Salim to remove Naina's chair and makes her work standing beside him while staff laugh.

state_changes.fact: She is publicly demoted in status during her first hearing.
He participates in removing Naina's chair under Devraj's instruction.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Devraj directs that Meera retain access to the twelve-acre orchard until documents are submitted, and Harish agrees to obey.

state_changes.fact: Her access to the orchard is temporarily protected by Devraj's direction.
He commits to obeying the tribunal because he believes it is lawful.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Naina opens the supposedly five-year-old master register and finds it blank except for the case she entered that morning.

state_changes.fact: She knows the tribunal's master register contains no history before her first entry.
Its claimed five-year history is contradicted by its blank pages.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Devraj orders Naina to backfill the master register with an index of 326 cases for which no files or archive references are produced.

state_changes.fact: She is compelled to create continuity for 326 unsupported case numbers.
It gains an invented five-year index of 326 cases.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Devraj dictates an order granting Meera exclusive possession before the siblings submit their evidence, and Pooja types it.

state_changes.fact: She prepares Meera's result before the document hearing.
She learns that Devraj determines outcomes before hearings.
It is prepared before the evidence hearing.

beat_sheet.what_happened: An unnoticed carbon copy of Meera's pretyped judgment slips beneath the skirting board and remains there.

state_changes.fact: It survives as independent proof that Meera's judgment was typed before the hearing.

beat_sheet.note: No character notices the carbon copy sliding beneath the skirting board; the beat deliberately preserves open canon for its later discovery.

beat_sheet.what_happened: After Naina completes the false index, Devraj places her signed employment declaration inside the register and says police will treat the author as the court's creator.

state_changes.fact: Her signed declaration is physically linked to the fabricated register.
He gains documentary leverage to direct suspicion toward Naina.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Devraj finds the word orchard misspelled in Meera's order and assigns responsibility to Naina because she certified the copy.

state_changes.fact: She is publicly designated responsible for a typing error she did not type.
Its spelling defect becomes an official issue.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Before the siblings and staff, Devraj docks Naina's full monthly salary of eleven thousand eight hundred rupees for the spelling error.

state_changes.fact: She loses her entire month's salary.
He reasserts control by attaching a specific financial penalty to Naina.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Devraj makes Naina stand on the bench and apologise to Meera and the absent Harish for the defective order and for causing doubt about the tribunal.

state_changes.fact: She publicly apologises under threat of losing her probationary appointment.
She hears Naina accept responsibility for failing to stop the defective order.

beat_sheet.note: Harish has left the room to retrieve his issued copy and does not hear the apology directly.

beat_sheet.what_happened: Harish returns carrying the orchard order beside Arvind, who publicly identifies Naina as the typist he previously dismissed.

state_changes.fact: Her former professional failure is exposed inside the tribunal.
He enters the tribunal and recognises Naina.

promise_ledger.listener_is_waiting_for: Why the supposedly five-year-old master register contains only Naina's first case.
promise_ledger.how_paid: Devraj produces a numbering sheet and forces Naina to manufacture an index of 326 unsupported cases.

promise_ledger.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether Devraj's tribunal has genuine authority from a competent court.
Who will find and use the surviving carbon copy of Meera's pretyped judgment.
Whether Naina's declaration and fabricated handwriting will cause police to treat her as the tribunal's creator.
What Arvind will do after recognising the former typist he dismissed inside the tribunal.

dates_fixed.what: Naina begins work and records Meera versus Harish as her first tribunal case.
After closing time, Devraj forces Naina to create the 326-case index.
The orchard order's spelling error is addressed publicly and Arvind arrives.
